children: Plenty of countries want to work more closely with Germany and Berlin will make the most of those opportunities independently of what U.S. President Donald Trump says, German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Friday.

"We should try to detach ourselves a little from whatever mood Donald Trump is in at the moment, what's on his mind and whatever he's threatening to do next," Klingbeil said ahead of the meetintg of finance ministers in Dublin.
